execution_ref_policy: Resolve the immutable execution commit from GITHUB_SHA and record it in the artifact.

one_changed_factor.name: entropy_cost
one_changed_factor.rationale: Re-run the remaining official entropy value after adding fail-closed routing checks. Keep architecture, sources, data, seeds, split, frames, actor count, batch size, unroll length, and matched evaluation instances fixed.

required_artifacts: three checkpoints with actual frame count, bytes and SHA-256
per-seed peak RSS and training wall time
policy entropy and episode termination statistics
pre-mask and post-mask logits plus invalid-action probability mass
actual entropy value and complete command for every seed
raw install, training, evaluation and qualification logs
qualification: entropy_cost=0.005 proven in summary, every seed record, and every seed command
correct win rate greater than random
three-seed mean improves and minimum seed does not regress
failure_policy: If 0.005 reaches every seed command and Correct still does not exceed Random or has zero success, reject entropy_cost as the sole cause and continue with official evaluation/default parity as the next single factor. If no job starts, record it as an execution blocker rather than a model result. Do not close the iteration until the next screening contract is issued or a preregistered stop condition is met.
